title: run_event schema: a versioned run-incarnation field, if ticfac decides it needs one
description:
Routed from ticfac (run epic-9pd, tick 55i, attempt 2): ticfac.run_event.v1 in the contract bundle (contracts/run-event-feed.json) is closed with additionalProperties: false, so a subscriber following one run's feed from offset zero across a resume cannot tell one incarnation's terminal line from another's.

Not to be started on its own. The need is decided on the ticfac side as tick pengelbrecht/ticfac:fxd, tied to the dashboard feed design. If ticfac decides it needs the field, this is the versioned schema change here; if not, close this with that decision.

Reminder for whoever does it: the bundle is digest-pinned in ticfac and verify-upstream byte-verifies against ticks shas, so the change lands here first and merges as a merge commit.
acceptance_criteria: Either run_event gains a versioned incarnation field in the bundle with a golden and an invalid fixture, or this tick is closed citing the ticfac decision not to
